outcome: general practitioners' competence to provide surgical skills training
cohort: The study included interns who completed their internship in 2008 in Mpumalanga and Gauteng, South Africa, and general practitioners affiliated with the University of Pretoria.
finding: While most general practitioners lacked the competence to provide training in some core surgical skills, interns who worked in semi-urban regions felt more competent in these skills compared to those in urban areas.
mod_finding: Interns perceived themselves to be competent in Caesarean sections.
